## News:

### Aerospace Briefing

Updates from aerospace industry reporting, recently published research, and open funding calls. Sources are checked every six hours; summaries link to the original material.

```{=html}
<section id="auto-news" aria-label="Latest aerospace news, research and funding">
	<p id="auto-news-status" role="status">Loading the latest updates...</p>
	<nav class="auto-news-nav" aria-label="News sections">
		<a href="#auto-news-industry-title">Industry</a>
		<a href="#auto-news-papers-title">Recent Papers</a>
		<a href="#auto-news-funding-title">Funding</a>
	</nav>
	<div class="auto-news-grid">
		<section class="auto-news-group" aria-labelledby="auto-news-industry-title">
			<h4 id="auto-news-industry-title">Industry</h4>
			<ul id="auto-news-industry" class="auto-news-list"></ul>
		</section>
		<section class="auto-news-group" aria-labelledby="auto-news-papers-title">
			<h4 id="auto-news-papers-title">Recent papers</h4>
			<ul id="auto-news-papers" class="auto-news-list"></ul>
		</section>
		<section class="auto-news-group" aria-labelledby="auto-news-funding-title">
			<h4 id="auto-news-funding-title">Funding opportunities</h4>
			<ul id="auto-news-funding" class="auto-news-list"></ul>
		</section>
	</div>
	<p id="auto-news-updated" class="auto-news-updated"></p>
</section>
<style>
	#auto-news { margin: 1.5rem 0 2.5rem; }
	.auto-news-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .65rem; margin: .8rem 0 1.25rem; }
	.auto-news-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #00abf0; border-radius: 6px; background: #00abf0; color: #081b29; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
	.auto-news-nav a:hover { background: transparent; color: #00abf0; text-decoration: none; }
	.auto-news-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }
	.auto-news-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 17rem), 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }
	.auto-news-group { border-top: 2px solid #187b77; padding-top: .7rem; min-width: 0; scroll-margin-top: 5rem; }
	.auto-news-group h4 { margin: 0 0 .7rem; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #ff5252; }
	.auto-news-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
	.auto-news-list li { border-bottom: 1px solid #d8e0df; padding: .7rem 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
	#auto-news .auto-news-list a, #auto-news .auto-news-list a:visited { color: #fff; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; }
	#auto-news .auto-news-list a:hover, #auto-news .auto-news-list a:focus-visible { color: #00abf0; text-decoration: none; }
	.auto-news-meta, .auto-news-summary, .auto-news-updated { color: #596665; font-size: .9rem; }
	.auto-news-meta { margin: .2rem 0; }
	.auto-news-summary { margin: .35rem 0 0; }
	@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
		.auto-news-group { animation: auto-news-arrive .35s ease-out both; }
		.auto-news-group:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .08s; }
		.auto-news-group:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .16s; }
		@keyframes auto-news-arrive { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
	}
</style>
<script>
	(() => {
		const status = document.getElementById("auto-news-status");
		const text = (value) => document.createTextNode(value || "");
		const renderItems = (targetId, items, showSummary) => {
			const list = document.getElementById(targetId);
			for (const item of items || []) {
				const row = document.createElement("li");
				const link = document.createElement("a");
				link.href = item.url;
				link.target = "_blank";
				link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
				link.append(text(item.title));
				row.append(link);
				const meta = document.createElement("p");
				meta.className = "auto-news-meta";
				meta.append(text([item.source, item.date, item.status, (item.topics || []).join(", ")].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")));
				row.append(meta);
				if (showSummary && item.summary) {
					const summary = document.createElement("p");
					summary.className = "auto-news-summary";
					summary.append(text(item.summary));
					row.append(summary);
				}
				list.append(row);
			}
			if (!list.children.length) {
				const row = document.createElement("li");
				row.append(text("No matching updates right now."));
				list.append(row);
			}
		};
		fetch("auto-news.json", { cache: "no-store" })
			.then((response) => {
				if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Feed unavailable");
				return response.json();
			})
			.then((data) => {
				renderItems("auto-news-industry", data.industry, true);
				renderItems("auto-news-papers", data.papers, true);
				renderItems("auto-news-funding", data.funding, false);
				status.textContent = "Latest updates from trusted public sources.";
				document.getElementById("auto-news-updated").textContent =
					`Feed last refreshed ${new Date(data.updated).toLocaleString()}.`;
			})
			.catch(() => {
				status.textContent = "Automatic updates are temporarily unavailable. Please check back later.";
				document.getElementById("auto-news-updated").textContent = "";
			});
	})();
</script>
```
